purpose: Design previews only; no directory code changed.
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, photorealistic high-fidelity website design proposal image for the Wedding Market boutique directory, desktop view plus a narrow mobile view on the right (about 25% width). Warm ivory #faf8f4, espresso #332d27, champagne, elegant GT Super Light-like serif display, sparse Lucia-style calligraphy accents, small Acumin-like regular sans interface. No bold heavy headlines, no botanical decoration, no extra company tagline. Website wordmark exactly WEDDING MARKET. Existing nav: Proveedores, Vestidos y trajes, Nosotros, Blog, EN ES, Solicitar cotizaciones, Inicia sesión. Main section is dresses and suits boutiques in Costa Rica. Existing examples are Atelier Alba in Escazú · San José, Casa Marfil in Belén · Heredia, Sastrería Roble in San José. Show tasteful bridal boutique photography and wedding tailoring, portrait photos should have visual variety, ivory wedding dresses and dark suits. Keep no more than these 3 example boutiques. Do not invent reviews, star ratings, verified badges, booking counts, designer brands, discounts, partner logos or inflated business claims. This is a concept preview only. All interface text Spanish, concise and legible, generous but purposeful spacing, delicate borders and restrained button design, polished and practical, coherent with a luxury wedding marketplace. Label the proposal clearly at top outside the webpage design. Both desktop and mobile should represent the same design. Proposal label: A — Atelier editorial. Design an elegant magazine-like directory with an ivory editorial split introduction: left graceful light serif heading 'Encuentra tu look de boda' and short intro 'Boutiques para descubrir vestidos, trajes y una atención personal.' On the right an elegant small portrait vignette of a wedding dress on a rail beside a suit, integrated into the intro without a large hero. Under introduction, slender horizontal controls 'Todas' 'Vestidos' 'Trajes', with a fine underline for selected Todas, location select 'Costa Rica' at right. Directory is an asymmetrical editorial photo grid: first boutique large immersive photo with bottom gradient and company logo monogram, brand name and location; next two boutiques equally-sized adjacent portrait images. Clear subtle arrow 'Explorar colección'. No white card boxes around photos; enough typography and brand identity under or over the imagery, do not repeat the generic word Boutiques on every card. Mobile shows concise intro, filters, one photo-led card at a time. Show the first two mobile cards within tall mobile composition. Desktop should fit intro and three boutique cards, magazine quality.
